summary: Iteration 61 - Dashboard Action Items & Email Notifications feature verified. All backend endpoints work correctly, frontend displays action item widgets with proper styling and navigation.

(5) email_helpers.py module exists with notify_task_assigned, notify_checkin, notify_task_overdue functions. (6) Task assignment triggers email notification code path (Resend API configured in backend/.env). (7) Parent check-in endpoint returns email_sent field. Note: Resend API key is configured so emails may actually send.
